title: Finite-evaluation bridge for the ordinary reduction/tensor pullback component
statement: Assume the finite-component characterizations from [lem-coef-tensor-reduction-strict-assembly] for the strict reduction maps at the source and target. Then the degree-n ordinary reduction/tensor pullback component identity holds, using [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], [lem-pur-sequence-pullback-tensor-cochain], and [lem-sf-scalar-pull-coefficient-total-tensor].

source.place: First paragraph, finite-component calculation before cochain extensionality; Stacks tags 07A4, 07A6, 0941.

proof.text: Define the reduction unit section by projecting the actual ordinary reduction/limit adjunction unit. Projection naturality and the normalized reduction/evaluation comparison identify this with the finite scalar unit followed by its evaluation isomorphism. For each homogeneous total tensor generator, use hV or hU to replace the evaluated strict map by tensorReductionFiniteComponent. Cancel its inverse reduction/evaluation comparison and its inverse tensor/evaluation comparison. The scalar tensor generator law, tensor-map generator law, and evaluation tensor generator law show that strict reduction sends the reduction unit of a tensor generator to the tensor generator of the two reduction units.

Use the proved mate_projection and projection_map identities in PullQuotientOrdinaryProjectionSection. The normalization a.projections, and the identity-on-sections characterization of the sequence direct-image/evaluation comparison, give mate_redUnit: the canonical reduction/pullback mate sends the reduction unit of a geometric pullback unit to the sequence pullback unit of the reduction unit.

To compare the two degree-n maps, transpose through ordinary reduction/limit. Limits are determined by their projections; transport each projection by coefficientSequenceRestriction_evaluation and transpose through the geometric module pullback adjunction. Total tensor maps are determined by homogeneous pure tensors. On a generator, mate_redUnit and naturality of the sequence pullback unit move the left route to the sequence tensor comparison applied to the tensor of reduction units. Its prescribed unit formula gives the tensor of the successive units. On the right route, naturality of the reduction unit moves the integral total tensor comparison through it; proEtaleTensorPullbackTotal_generators computes that comparison. The strict reduction generator formula and the tensor-map generator formula then leave mate_redUnit on each of the two factors. These are exactly the same successive units. This proves the required degree-n equality without flatness or boundedness.

proof_origin.place: First-paragraph tensor compatibility, via actual adjunction units and homogeneous total generators; Stacks 03EL and 07A4. Complete Lean proof, no new obligations.

theorem canonicalReductionTensorPullComplex_component_bridge
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (a : OrdinaryLimitModel l E) {U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ V)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E V) ℤ) (n : ℤ)
    (hV : ∀ m : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E V m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (tensorReductionStrictMap l E V P Q) =
        tensorReductionFiniteComponent l E V P Q m)
    (hU : ∀ m : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E U m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (tensorReductionStrictMap l E U
          (((integralOrdinaryPull l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((integralOrdinaryPull l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) =
        tensorReductionFiniteComponent l E U
          (((integralOrdinaryPull l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((integralOrdinaryPull l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) m) :
    let F := (integralOrdinaryPull l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let R (W : Scheme.{u}) :=
      (pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let S := (pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let T := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology V)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E V)).obj (P, Q)
    (a.reductionPullComplex l E f T ≫
        S.map (tensorReductionStrictMap l E V P Q) ≫
        (pullbackTensorSequenceCochain l E f).hom.app ((R V).obj P, (R V).obj Q)).f n =
      ((R U).map
          (proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring V)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring U)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f) P Q).inv ≫
        tensorReductionStrictMap l E U (F.obj P) (F.obj Q) ≫
        (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u}
          (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology U))
          (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E U)).map
          (Prod.mkHom (a.reductionPullComplex l E f P)
            (a.reductionPullComplex l E f Q))).f n
